QuestInfo.0: Maybe the alchemist #p2111006# saw is #r#p2111002##k, the missing alchemist! I better go see #b#p2111006##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2111006# tilted his head a bit as if he was having a headache, and frowned. Next thing you know, I was spotted at a different place. This may seem familiar, but this place also seems a bit strange. Where is this? And who's that #rguy#k?
QuestInfo.2: Oh my gosh! The person that's standing in the lab is indeed #p2111002#! #p2111006#...! Wait, so this place is really #b#p2111002#'s lab#k?

0.0: Oh, welcome! You've done a wonderful job of clearing up my little boredom problem. Now then, you wanted to know about that one alchemist, yes?
0.1: Well, the thing about that is... He was never particularly memorable, you see. What I'm trying to say here is, well, I forgot.
0.2: I suggest you just go and find that person yourself. See with your own eyes!

no.0: Look, if you don't want to, that's your choice. I just can't tell you about that alchemist, that's all.

1.0: ...can I help you? This is a private lab, and no one is allowed in, but...

npc.0: Hmm? I guess you haven't met him yet... Do you not wish to go to the world of afterimage? Let me know if you are ready to head there.
